citation: SEAM, Drosophila Connectomics group; mask assessor trained on the Aedes reconstruction's edit history

input.name: lab
input.made_by: seam/segclr/patches.py: patch_box (the box) -> label_box (supervoxels labelled by each object's leaves) -> pair_sides (the patch)

patch.segmentation: Aedes supervoxels at mip 1 (32 x 32 x 45 nm)
patch.z: resampled to 32 nm, labels by nearest section
patch.objects: Q: the neuron's root, C: the candidate's root, both at the set's snapshot - 1 ms (Coda fixture: search.roots_at)

parity.against: PyTorch fp32 (lists.parquet torch_s<k>) on the fixture's lists
must: the shown decision (q >= the cutoff; stages 7-9 with the Coda fixture's fits, its stored head scores and e_tip) is the same on every tip
ref's first candidate is the same on every list
q is within 0.01 on every tip
per seed, first place is the same on every list whose fp32 top two differ by more than 0.05
per seed, the rank correlation (Spearman) within each list of 5+ candidates is at least 0.99
